why_agent_cannot: log in or create the account (human session)
what_human_must_do: Log in / create the account in the shared profile, then the agent can continue.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Log in on the Infinity Warlords site Open the login page to sign in to the game.
2 Step 2 : Start playing from your profile Use the Play Now entry on the homepage, which leads to your profile , and begin leveling up your Warlord character.

3 Step 3 : Invite friends to play The homepage pairs playing with inviting friends as the way to earn ISHA. The How to Get Started page of the whitepaper is the place to look for the onboarding details.
4 Step 4 : Follow the leaderboards The homepage links a leaderboard at that address, and the whitepaper says weekly rankings follow player activity.
5 Step 5 : Read the whitepaper for reward details The whitepaper index lists Token, Battle Pass and Referral System sections, and the Token section covers ISHA and its applications in the game.
